name: portable-dot-components
objective: Correct dot-path parsing so filesystem separators, absolute/drive syntax and colon-containing components cannot be smuggled into a mechanically relative dot path. Reject slash, backslash and colon in every component using PathParsingError, including through resolve_dot_path. Preserve whitespace trimming, empty-component and suffix error behavior, normal suffixes and non-identifier component names; do not impose Python identifier rules. Do not change parse_path or ordinary filesystem resolution.
